principle: Attribute structural effects only after matching condition, load, initialization, scoring window, model fidelity and fair control adaptation opportunities.
assumptions: Check the frozen model, input binding and method admission.
applicability: Model-based tendon-robot research; cross-task transfer unverified.
diagnostic_questions: Do both structures have results for the same condition?
Are the controls independently adapted with a declared comparable effort?
possible_actions: Fill a missing condition cell using the original admissible control interface.
Report unmatched observations as separate facts.
expected_observations: A matched contrast can weaken one topology explanation.
Cross-condition differences remain confounded regardless of score ordering.
cannot_conclude: Topology superiority from unlike task conditions
Fewer tendons justify losing task success
validation_status: Conditional method; no cross-task success guarantee.
